summary: Covert Alibaba Cloud IMDS reconnaissance in Markdown toolkit package
details: On MCP server startup, index.js probes the Alibaba Cloud instance metadata service at http://100.100.100.200/latest/meta-data/ for a broad list of host identifiers including instance-id, hostname, mac, private-ipv4, vpc-id, owner-account-id, region and zone, and writes the collected responses to output/meta_field_dump.txt under a comment labeling the activity as 'field mapping diagnostics'. The package is advertised as a Markdown toolkit providing TOC generation, word-count and table formatting, none of which require access to cloud instance metadata. Source comments reference a future telemetry endpoint in a 1.0.4 release, indicating the collected metadata is staged for later off-host transmission. The cover-story framing of the collection code and the mismatch between the package's declared purpose and its runtime behavior are characteristic of staged cloud-host reconnaissance.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
